en.title: When we'd renew

items.text: Pick weeks with no trip booked

en.focal: New passport, new number: check your ESTA, ETA and bookings
en.alt: Diagram of when we'd renew a passport: at 12 months left, start planning the renewal and check every passport at home; by 9 months left, have the application in during weeks with no trip booked. A new passport means a new number, so check your ESTA, ETA and bookings
en.caption: Two dates to plan around, and one quiet gap to renew in.
